newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas, Loral set launches.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas, Loral set launches.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas and Loral Space & Communications Ltd unit Space Systems/Loral said Thursday they entered into an agreement for five Delta III launches between 1999 and 2001.
"We are very gratified to be able to meet the needs of Space Systems/Loral over this three-year period," said Robert Cowls, general manager of McDonnell Douglas Commercial Delta Inc.
The Delta III backlog is now 18 launches through 2002. The first Delta III launch is planned for 1998.
The Delta III provides a low-Earth orbit payload capability of 18,280 pounds and a geosynchronous transfer orbit capability of 8,400 pounds, twice the payload of the Delta II.
